comments.text: An American expat with some Laotian DMV problem was sought out by a traffic cop who would require a $20 bribe every time he caught him.  No Laos for me.

comments.text: The country is underdeveloped compared to its neighbors. And if you need medical care, it’s best to fly to Bangkok immediately. It is illegal to have a local girl as a guest in your hotel. But if you’re careful, you can still have a good time.
